images.title: One formula averages a range
images.purpose: Shows that =AVERAGE(B7:D7) adds Gowri's three marks and divides by 3 to give 30.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One row of three spreadsheet cells in the centre, a formula bar above them and one result cell to the right.
images.exact_structure: Three equal rectangular spreadsheet cells side by side with thin grey (#6B7280) borders, filled very light teal (#0072B2) to show they are the chosen range, with a thicker teal outline around all three. Small grey cell names above each cell: B7, C7, D7. Inside the cells: 27, 29, 34. Above the row, a wide white formula bar with a thin dark outline holding =AVERAGE(B7:D7). To the right of D7, a thin grey arrow points to one more cell with a thick reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline holding 30. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: AVERAGE adds the cells in the range and divides by how many there are: 90 ÷ 3 = 30.
images.description: Shows that =AVERAGE(B7:D7) adds Gowri's three marks and divides by 3 to give 30.

image_decisions.why: One row of cells with its formula shows the whole idea of AVERAGE over a range.
